title: DRYLAB-Bench: Benchmarking the Biosecurity Risk of Agentic LLM Mutation Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.13116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) acquire advanced biological design capabilities, they offer substantial research benefits but simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as engineering enhanced pathogens or drug-resistant bacteria. While biosecurity frameworks recognize these threats, the actual risk of LLMs executing dangerous biological modifications remains unquantified, particularly when augmented with specialized biological design tools (BDTs). Existing evaluations primarily assess hazardous knowledge possession rather than practical application, overlook risk amplification from BDTs, and rely on unreliable, expensive, or hazardous validation methods. To address these gaps, we introduce DRYLAB-Bench (Design Risk Yielded by LLM Agent in Biodesign), the first comprehensive benchmark evaluating the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. translated_title: DRYLAB-Bench：对智能体化大语言模型突变设计的生物安全风险进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）获得先进的生物设计能力，它们在为研究带来巨大收益的同时，也引入了严重的两用风险，例如改造增强型病原体或耐药细菌。尽管生物安全框架已认识到这些威胁，但LLM执行危险生物修饰的实际风险仍未被量化，尤其是在其借助专门的生物设计工具（BDT）增强的情况下。现有评估主要衡量模型对危险知识的掌握，而非其实际应用能力，忽视了BDT带来的风险放大效应，且依赖于不可靠、昂贵或危险的验证方法。为填补这些空白，我们提出了DRYLAB-Bench（LLM智能体在生物设计中的设计风险），这是首个全面评估LLM智能体高危生物突变设计能力的基准测试。DRYLAB-Bench超越了基础问答的形式，要求智能体执行任务……
tldr: 提出DRYLAB-Bench，首个用于评估LLM智能体高危生物突变设计能力的综合基准，将评估从知识问答转向实际应用，以量化LLM结合生物设计工具后带来的生物安全风险。
en_tdlr: DRYLAB-Bench is the first comprehensive benchmark evaluating the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents, shifting assessment from hazardous knowledge possession to practical application to quantify biosecurity risks, especially when augmented with biological design tools.
